summary: Frontend-only visual/regression testing of TITAN dashboard (iteration 6). VISUAL FIX 1 verified: welcome-card coin img is fully inside welcome-status-card bounds (imgRight 365 <= cardRight 374 at 390px) at 360/390/430 and no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth at all three). VISUAL FIX 2 verified: all 8 .grad-label elements (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY POOL + GLOBAL BUSINESS, MY BUSINESS, TEAM REWARD, RECENT ACTIVITY, TOP TTN HOLDERS) have linear-gradient(90deg,#22C55E->#65B82E->#D6C51E), background-clip:text, transparent color and non-zero size with correct visible text. Regression: demo SIWE connect works (new Inactive UID each time), welcome-uid/status/ttn-price $10.00/price-sparkline, referral copy toast, 3 full-width pool cards with live countdowns + eligibility pills, MyBusiness stake/mine/sell 'next module' toasts, total-profit donut + 5 legend rows, Team Reward, onchain-data-link, recent-activity, holders search (200 holders, 10/page, filter -> 1 row, 'No holders found' empty state, next/prev pagination), activation (min $10 validation toast; $50 -> Active in welcome + header, activate-card removed, pills -> Eligible, Activation row in recent activity), bottom nav all 4 Coming Soon screens + return to dashboard. Backend NOT re-run per request.

ui_bugs.issue: On initial page load the countdowns render 'NaN:NaN:NaN' for ~1s before the first interval tick. Cause: useState initializer runs diff(undefined) which returns {d:NaN,...} (NaN <= 0 is false so the null guard is skipped); state is only corrected 1000ms later. Fix: guard for invalid dates in diff() (return null when isNaN) and recompute t in a useEffect on target change.

navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...) promise is not caught. When clipboard permission is denied (headless/iOS Safari/non-secure context) it throws an unhandled NotAllowedError -> CRA 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay covers the screen and blocks all clicks (Playwright clicks intercepted by #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay). Add .catch() with a fallback (textarea+execCommand) and an error toast.

issues: 'TOTAL PROFIT' label still uses old .section-label (plain gray) while all other section/pool titles are now grad-label gradient - visually inconsistent with the new theme; same for other inner card labels (AVAILABLE MINING CAP, GENERATED REWARD, DIRECT/LEVEL REWARD) if a uniform look is intended.

action_items: Wrap clipboard writeText in try/catch + fallback so a denied clipboard permission cannot produce an unhandled rejection / error overlay (ReferralCard.jsx:11, Header.jsx:34).
Fix Countdown NaN flash on first render (invalid-date guard in diff() + recompute on target change).
Optional theme polish: apply grad-label to TOTAL PROFIT and other inner card labels for consistency.

Holder rows and profit-legend rows had no data-testid (added by tester) - keep row-level testids for list/pagination assertions.
